answer_1.quote: Our main experiments use three datasets: (1) OpenGen, a dataset ... open-ended generation ... (2) LFQA, a dataset ... long-form question answering ... (3) Re-alNews, a subset of C4 ...

answer_2.quote: We use FactScore, an automatic metric that measures the percentage of atomic claims ... We also compute cosine similarity between embeddings ...

answer_3.quote: We adopt the LLM-as-a-judge setup to perform a pairwise comparison task. We choose GPT-4-Turbo as our judge ...

answer_4.quote: We hire two annotators fluent in English and conduct two human annotation studies ... annotators read prefixes and corresponding pairs ... indicate their preferred response overall, as well as preferences in relevance, coherence, and interestingness ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to judge overall preference and rate relevance, coherence, and interestingness of each response; in a separate study they were asked to highlight out-of-place words they thought might have been inserted.
